sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
res=action(['RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT'])
fr=current_frame
rows=fr.ascii.split('\n')
# beam extent
s=set()
for r in range(50):
    for c in range(16,64):
        if rows[r][c] in 'wg': s.add((r,c))
print("beam rows",sorted(set(p[0] for p in s)),"cols",min(p[1] for p in s),max(p[1] for p in s))
# squares present?
sq={}
for nd in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
    if nd['color'] in 'RbN' and nd['pixels']==16:
        rs=[p[0] for p in nd['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in nd['boundary']]
        sq.setdefault(nd['color'],[]).append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
print("squares",sq)
print("res",last_action_result.get('board_changed'),last_action_result.get('level_completed'),last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
